verses.text: Praise the LORD! My soul, praise the LORD!
I’ll praise the LORD my whole life. I’ll sing praises to my God as long as I’m here.
Don’t put your trust in rulers or in any mortal who can’t save you.
Their spirit leaves them, and back to the earth they go. That very day, their plans die with them.
Happy is the person whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD their God,
the one who made heaven and earth and the sea with everything in them, the one who stays true forever,
who brings justice to people held down and gives food to hungry people. The LORD sets prisoners free.
The LORD opens blind eyes. The LORD lifts people bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous.
The LORD guards foreigners. He helps the fatherless and the widow but flips the road of the wicked upside down.
The LORD will reign forever. Zion, your God reigns through every generation. Praise the LORD!
